Name: Access Administration and Verify Admin Page
Description: Navigate to the dashboard, access administration, open sites, and verify the admin page.
Test Steps:
Step 1: Navigate to /dashboard
Step 2: Click on button administration
Step 3: Click on link sites
Step 4: Click on link uploadSites -> Navigate to page '/admin'
Step 5: Take full page screenshot as checkpoint
